test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Awareness (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is NOT TRUE about Rash Behari Bose?

options.text: He founded Indian Independence League in Tokyo in 1942.
He was an important figure in the Ghadar Movement and in the formation of the Azad Hind Fauj.
He was honoured with the prestigious title 'Order of the rising sun'.
He was independent India's first Commander-in-Chief of Indian Army.

solution:
The incorrect answer is __**He was independent India's first Commander-in-Chief of Indian Army.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rash Behari Bose was never the Commander-in-Chief of independent India's army; the first Commander-in-Chief was General K. M. Cariappa, appointed in 1949.
 
• He played a crucial role in revolutionary activities against British rule, including his involvement in the Ghadar Movement.
 
• Rash Behari Bose founded the Indian Independence League in Tokyo in 1942 to garner support for India's freedom struggle.
 
• He was instrumental in laying the groundwork for the formation of the Azad Hind Fauj (Indian National Army), later led by Subhas Chandra Bose.
 
• Japan honored Rash Behari Bose with the prestigious title "Order of the Rising Sun" for his contributions to India's independence movement and his association with Japan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ghadar Movement:**

 
 
• An early 20th-century revolutionary movement aimed at overthrowing British rule in India.
 
• It was initiated by Indian expatriates, primarily in North America, and spread globally.
 
 
 
• **Indian Independence League:**
 
 
• Founded by Rash Behari Bose in Tokyo in 1942 to organize Indians living abroad for the freedom struggle.
 
• It served as a precursor to the Azad Hind Fauj (Indian National Army).
 
 
 
• **Azad Hind Fauj (Indian National Army):**
 
 
• A military organization formed to fight for India's independence from British rule.
 
• Subhas Chandra Bose later took leadership of the INA and expanded its role significantly.
 
 
 
• **Order of the Rising Sun:**
 
 
• A prestigious honor awarded by Japan to Rash Behari Bose for his contributions to India's freedom struggle and his collaboration with Japanese authorities.
 
• This award signifies the close ties between Rash Behari Bose and Japan during the independence movement.
 
 
 
• **General K. M. Cariappa:**
 
 
• The first Commander-in-Chief of the Indian Army after India gained independence in 1947.
 
• He took over as Commander-in-Chief from British General Sir Francis Robert Roy Bucher in 1949.
